scientific_intent.discretization: Full131 by97 spatial grids, T13 L2.65, original theta45 radians plus0 radians, centered at half dimensions
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All25414 Float64 values finite, 1e-16+1e-12relative against native CPU and independent extended-precision expression; strengthens original1e-3. Additional central-reflection symmetry at theta0.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 131x97 grids with partial16x16 edge workgroups, 2 complete angular fixtures,100 repeats
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Double exp/cos and cancellation near carrier zeros; absolute floor handles tiny filter tails, relative checks meaningful near peak. Original weak absolute1e-3 alone is insufficient to distinguish all shape changes.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Oriented spatial-frequency filter generation for image and signal analysis; no downstream image classification or biological inference claimed.
scientific_intent.description: A Gaussian envelope and oriented cosine carrier form a complete two-dimensional Gabor filter field. The original numeric theta45 is passed directly to sin/cos in radians, and is preserved without silently converting to degrees.
scientific_intent.provenance: Actual native gabor kernel and generateGaborKernelHost in reference.h; image/signal filter role follows source operation, no particular dataset or downstream workflow attributed.
